title: ASN.1 PER dissectors: VAL_PTR pointer-sign issues on integers
description:
In a few cases the sign of the value pointer from
dissect_per_constrained_integer[_64b] is wrong for the actual
type. We probably should have function variants that are separate
for the signed and unsigned field types, similar to 64 bit.

Ping #20175

commits_data.title: ASN.1 PER dissectors: VAL_PTR pointer-sign issues on integers
commits_data.message:
ASN.1 PER dissectors: VAL_PTR pointer-sign issues on integers

In a few cases the sign of the value pointer from
dissect_per_constrained_integer[_64b] is wrong for the actual
type. We probably should have function variants that are separate
for the signed and unsigned field types, similar to 64 bit.

Ping #20175
